notes.title: Bullet Trajectory Bug Investigation
notes.notes:
Hi RD Mars fans!

I've just been made aware of a new bug concerning bullet trajectory and animation. I apologize dearly to those who have had a subpar experience with RD Mars due to this bug, and I am working to fix it ASAP. From my understanding the bug has only affected a small portion of players. 


If you've experienced-

-Bullets pointing in random directions
-White/Red bullets that move random directions (outside of the level 4 boss fight)
-Boss fights that seem wildly outside the normal difficulty curve (bosses that are too easy due to bullets not being directed at player)
-General poor bullet patterns that seem unintentional


Please send me an email at lucidpotudev@gmail.com and I will work with you to address the issue. Thank you for playing RD Mars!
